title: RuangRiung joins the project catalog
summary:
A quieter day: a bilingual image app joined the catalog, while text API ad controls and agent-readable API metadata got updates.

The project catalog added RuangRiung AI Image Generator, a web app that supports Indonesian and English.

Text API ad selection gained configurable domain matching for referrer headers, with a fallback to origin information when no referrer is present. Matching domains can be selected for ads on every request.

Five public resources now describe API endpoints, models, capabilities, and usage for AI agents and developers, including llms.txt, agents.json, arazzo.json, and mcp.json.
